leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a cross-functional collaboration framework by defining key roles and responsibilities
Implement communication protocols for different stakeholder groups within the project structure
Configure shared documentation systems that maintain consistency across functional teams
Integrate feedback mechanisms from multiple departments into the development workflow
Apply conflict resolution strategies when priorities between teams diverge
Initialize regular sync processes that align engineering timelines with business objectives
Render progress dashboards that visualize cross-team dependencies and blockers
